name: OmniNews Oracle
tagline: Verified local-to-national news intelligence for TryAMM
rules: No source is enabled until license, attribution, redistribution and rate-limit terms are recorded.
Do not scrape full copyrighted articles unless a contract, license or site terms explicitly permit it.
Prefer metadata, excerpts and links when full-content rights are absent.
Community submissions remain unverified until editorial review and source corroboration.
Weather, finance and sports values must retain provider timestamps and source attribution.
AI may summarize and cluster but cannot upgrade an unverified item to verified without an authorized review step.

levels.name: Community Correspondent
levels.scope: neighborhood, school, church, nonprofit, creator and local event coverage

levels.name: Local Anchor
levels.scope: city and county daily briefs, interviews, weather and local public-interest coverage

levels.name: National OmniNews Anchor
levels.scope: national programs, breaking-news desk, major interviews and specials
